description: Audit a spreadsheet file (.xlsx, .xlsm, .ods, .xls) by RECALCULATING every formula and comparing it with the value saved in the file: cells whose saved value no longer matches its formula (stale or hand-overwritten results), real circular references, functions the recalculation engine does not support, and formula errors. Returns only the problem cells, each with sheet, address, formula, saved and recalculated value; healthy formulas are just counted. Reads the file from disk: pass its path.
name: spreadsheet_audit
